name: Robert Whittaker

tale_of_tape.source: data/derived/fighters.json (72 in height, 73 in reach); 205.5 lb at the UFC 329 weigh-in (Jul 2026, light-heavyweight debut). Previously a middleweight (185 lb).

photo_coverage: Good. Current (Jul 2026) studio headshot and full-body cutout, a Jul 2025 cutout, two Jul 2026 press-conference faces and two Jul 2026 action shots (three-quarter face). Profile coverage is weaker: the best side view (c4, Jun 2024 face-off) is partly blocked by a camera. Five Commons files are freely licensed (four CC BY 3.0 video stills from 2022-2024 plus an uploader-asserted CC0 photo from about 2016); everything else is reference-only.

face.shape: Broad, squarish face of medium height: wide across the cheekbones and the jaw, with near-parallel sides. Lean, but the cheeks are not hollow. The top of the head is rounded under the buzz cut.
face.jaw: Wide, strong and straight, with the angles set out under the ears. The lower jaw is mostly under the goatee, but the 3/4 views (ESPN cutouts, UFC 329 action) show a heavy, straight jaw line running into a thick neck.
face.chin: Broad and of medium-to-long height, under the goatee. In the side view (c4) the chin plus beard projects a little past the lower lip.
face.cheekbones: Moderately wide and fairly high. The cheeks below are flat; a crease runs from the nose wing to the mouth corner when he smiles.
face.brow_ridge: Strong. The brows sit low, right on top of the upper lids, so the eyes look narrow and intense.
face.forehead: Medium height, broad and fairly upright. The front hairline is straight across with a mild recession at the temples.

eyes.shape: Almond with a medium-narrow opening and heavy, slightly hooded upper lids; outer corners level to slightly down

eyebrows.shape: Low and nearly straight, heaviest at the inner ends, with a gentle lift over the outer third; a clear gap between them
eyebrows.colour: very dark brown (the raw sample #764e40 is lightened by skin showing through; render near #2b1d18)

nose.tip: Rounded and fleshy, slightly wide; the nostrils show a little from the front
nose.fight_damage: No obvious deviation in the frontal views; the bridge is a little broad and flat, as is common after many fights.

face.mouth_lips: Medium width. Upper lip medium, lower lip fuller and rounder; lips pinkish. Corners level at rest; a wide, toothy smile in the press photos.

ears.cauliflower_ear: No obvious cauliflower ear: the folds look smooth and normal in the ESPN headshot zoom.
ears.note: They stand out slightly from the head.

face.notable_marks_scars: Fresh red marks on the forehead and around the brows after UFC 329 (Jul 2026); no obvious permanent facial scar. Band tattoo on the left ring finger.

hair.style: Buzz cut: very short all over (top about 0.5-1 cm), tighter on the sides and back, no parting.
hair.colour_note: Very dark brown, near black. The raw ESPN sample from the top of the head is #44332d because scalp shows through the short hair; render the strands darker.
hair.hairline: Straight front line, set fairly low, with mild temple recession
hair.texture: Too short to judge; looks dense and coarse

facial_hair.detail: Full goatee: moustache joined to a chin beard that covers the chin and hangs about 3-4 cm below it (Jul 2026), trimmed to a rounded block about as wide as the mouth. Cheeks and the jaw line beyond the chin are shaved, with a faint stubble shadow. In mid-2024 it was longer (about 5 cm) and pointed; in 2016-2022 it was short (1-2 cm).
facial_hair.colour_note: Near-black brown. Raw ESPN chin sample #261711; lit strands #6b473a.
facial_hair.density: dense on the chin and moustache, thinner at the sides of the chin, none on the cheeks
facial_hair.shape: rounded rectangular chin block (2026); pointed in 2024

skin.tone_hex_method: plain RGB mean of the samples marked in_average (well-lit, near-neutral cheek and forehead-free patches); each sample is the median of the 25th-65th luma percentile pixels of the patch
skin.undertone: Warm, olive/golden. Tans evenly; no strong pink in the cheeks.
skin.freckles_marks: No visible freckles. Light hair on the forearms and legs, very little chest hair.
skin.note: The ESPN studio cheeks (#e9a383, #f1ad8d) are the most neutral reference. He is a light-medium olive tone: darker and more golden than Ankalaev or Shevchenko, lighter than Pantoja.

body.build: Compact, dense and muscular: 183 cm and 93 kg (205.5 lb) at the Jul 2026 weigh-in. A wide frame for his height; looks thick rather than long.
body.body_fat_note: Clear six-pack and obliques in the 2025 and 2026 ESPN cutouts and the UFC 329 photos; the lower abdomen is slightly softer.
body.shoulders: Broad, with round, well-capped deltoids and a strong trapezius rising into a thick neck
body.chest: Thick, square pectorals with a defined lower edge
body.arms: Muscular upper arms with big triceps and strong forearms; average arm length (reach only 2.5 cm more than height)
body.waist: Narrow next to the shoulders: a clear V-taper
body.legs_calves: Powerful thighs, medium calves, hairy legs
body.posture: Upright, square shoulders, chin slightly down
body.notable: The neck is about as wide as the jaw. Limbs are of average length, so the build reads compact and stocky next to rangier light heavyweights.

tattoos.where: right shoulder, right upper arm and right upper chest/collarbone
tattoos.description: Black Maori/Polynesian-style tribal piece: big koru spirals over the shoulder cap with hooked, patterned bands. It spills forward onto the right upper chest and collarbone, runs down the upper arm to about mid-biceps and wraps over the rear deltoid (side view c4).

tattoos.where: left chest, between collarbone and nipple
tattoos.description: Southern Cross constellation: five small seven-pointed stars in black outline (four larger, one small), laid out as on the Australian flag
Thin band tattoo (seen in the Feb 2024 weigh-in photo)

kit.fight_shorts: UFC 329 (Jul 2026): white Venum shorts with a grey leaf/scale print and green WHITTAKER lettering, blue-corner gloves (the Jul 2026 ESPN cutout shows the same white shorts). Jul 2025: black/charcoal tiger-stripe Venum shorts with crypto.com. Jun 2024: black shorts with a grey splatter print.
kit.walkout: Black Venum jacket with a green-and-gold kangaroo AUS patch on the left sleeve (UFC 329 presser)

morphs_if_available.note: Ear targets from the full MakeHuman set. They are not in the shipped assets/embed/mh-manifest.json, so they are listed here and not under morphs.

morphs_unavailable: Ears: no ear targets in the shipped manifest (full-set values under morphs_if_available). No target for the goatee, hair or the thick trapezius beyond neck-scale-horiz.
notes: Confidence: high for the overall look (buzz cut, low heavy straight brows, dark eyes, full goatee, broad square face, Maori right-shoulder piece, Southern Cross on the left chest, compact muscular build); medium for exact morph values. Watch for: (1) the tattoos are on his RIGHT shoulder and LEFT chest; mirroring them breaks the likeness; (2) goatee length changes between fights; default to the Jul 2026 rounded 3-4 cm block, not the long pointed 2024 version; (3) keep the brows low and heavy and the eye opening narrow, which carries most of his expression; (4) do not make him lanky: he is short-limbed and thick for a light heavyweight; (5) macro/heightUpM uses the linear fit in research/assets.md (heightUpM = 2 * (H - 1.785 m) / 0.875); muscle and weight change stature slightly, so measure the built mesh and nudge heightUpM until it reads 183 cm.

stance.source: Set 2026-11-06 from his documented fighting style: data/scouting/robert-whittaker.json (archetype, tags, signature and summary) and widely described stance traits. The ESPN stance cutouts (espn_stance_left.png, espn_stance_right.png) are posed standing shots, so they were used only for posture, shoulder set and build, not for the guard or footwork; fight footage would sharpen these values.
stance.notes: Karate-based: bladed, bouncing stance and fast in-and-out blitzes behind feints.
